candidates.source_description: What an unbelievable moment from Matt Wheatcroft. Faced with a terrible position right next to the boundary fence, he had almost no realistic path toward the green. Instead of taking relief, he took a huge gamble. He struck the ball straight into the fence. It bounced perfectly onto the putting surface, stopping inches from the hole. This lucky yet bold shot quickly went viral across the whole golf world.
